description: Build the X-Content-Type-Options header (only one valid value, "nosniff") with a plain-English explanation of the MIME-sniffing attack it prevents, optionally validating a pasted header value or assessing MIME-sniffing risk for a given Content-Type.

contentType.description: A Content-Type value to assess MIME-sniffing risk for, e.g. "text/plain"

headerValue.description: A pasted header value or full header line to validate, e.g. "nosniff"

name: build_x_content_type_options_header
